notes.title: Nekogumi Demo v1.03 & v1.04 Patch~
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes – Demo Update v1.03 & v1.04

26th September , 2025

🔧 Improvements

Added camera distance adjustment to the options menu

Edited demo end screen localization text for clarity across languages

🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixing camera system options 

Remapped and fixed manual buttons in the options menu

💡 Player Tips & Feedback

If the camera still feels a bit off, try adjusting the camera distance in the settings menu to find what feels best for you.

If you have further suggestions or run into issues, we encourage you to use the bug report or feedback form—constructive input helps us improve the experience for everyone. We need your input to improve Nekogumi, so we hope to hear from you~

💬 Dev Notes

Hello human~

Thanks again for all the feedback—yes, even a single bug report helps! As a solo developer, I read everything and try hard to make this game the best it can be. If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s a great time. And if you enjoyed it, consider leaving a review—it helps more than you know.

More updates coming soon!
— Ki-nodes Studio

notes.title: Nekogumi Demo v1.02 Patch~
notes.notes:
Hello human, 

Just a quick note to say thank you for wishlisting the game and checking out the demo. It’s been a week since our demo launch, and we’ve made some updates to camera and controls based on early feedback, hopefully things feel a bit…smoother now.

As a solo developer, every bit of feedback—yes, even just one bug report—means a lot. I read everything, and I try hard to make this game the best it can be. 

If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s a great time. And if you have, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world. And if you enjoyed it, consider leaving a review - it helps more than you know.

More updates coming soon!

Ki-nodes Studio
